content.title: Computing devices
content.notes: Candidates should identify the various computing devices since the beginning of counting/computing.

content.title: Concept of Number system in computing
content.notes: Should include the importance of number system to computing.

content.title: Generations of Computer: first, second, third, fourth, fifth generations of computer
content.notes: Relate each generation with its characteristic feature. Describe each generation under: year of development, basic component/type of technology, speed of operation, storage capacity/component.

content.title: Definition of data and information
content.notes: Differences between data and information should be emphasized.

content.title: Classify computers by: Type, Size, Usage

topics.topic: Application of ICT in everyday life

content.title: Uses of ICT in everyday activities
content.notes: The use and areas of ICT application should be linked to societal development.

content.title: Impact of ICT in the society

topics.notes: Examples of each component should be treated and how they are used in data processing.

content.title: Steps involved in Information Processing
content.notes: Description of each step involved in information processing is required.

content.title: Methods of transmitting information
content.notes: Modes of information transmission such as visuals (newspaper), audio (radio, telephone), audio-visual (GSM, Television) are required.

topics.notes: Medium of information transmission such as radio, television, newspaper etc.

content.title: Meaning of Networking, Internet and Intranet
content.notes: Significance of networking should be mentioned.

content.title: Types of Networking
content.notes: Types such as MAN, LAN, WAN should be treated.

topics.notes: Candidates should be able to develop skills in the use of various services available on the internet.
Differences between text (character) base interface and Graphical User Interface should be treated.

content.title: Starting, loading and exiting word processing

topics.notes: Candidates should be able to make use of word processor to create and manipulate documents.

content.title: Creating, saving and retrieving Spreadsheet files

topics.notes: Candidates should be able to make use of spreadsheet to create and manipulate worksheets.

content.title: Creating, saving and retrieving database files

topics.notes: Candidates should be able to use DBMS to create and manipulate Database files. Include examples of packages such as Microsoft Access.

content.title: Creating, saving and retrieving presentation files

topics.notes: Candidates should be able to use presentation programs to create and manipulate slides.
Designing of web pages not required.
Focus should be placed on Corel Draw.

sections.section_title: COMPUTER MAINTENANCE, ETHICS AND HUMAN ISSUES

content.title: Battery Charging and replacement for portable systems and UPS

topics.notes: Candidates should take note of basic maintenance procedures. Students should be able to ensure data integrity and recover data after a crash.
Responsible ways of using and securing computers should be emphasized.

content.title: Positioning of the monitor, keyboard, CPU, mouse and any other peripheral devices
Keep liquid away from the computer room

topics.notes: Importance of safety measures should be emphasized.

content.title: Qualities of a good data processing professional

topics.notes: Duties of each professional/professional bodies should be treated.
Destructive effects of virus infection on computers.

content.title: Database and table creation using application packages
content.notes: Arranging data in tables and forms should be emphasized.

content.title: Creating relationships between tables
content.notes: The concept of primary and foreign keys, entities, attributes and relationships should be emphasized.

content.title: Creation of forms, queries and report
content.notes: Query language should be limited to those available to the database application package (e.g. query by example, SQL).

content.title: Types of File organization
content.notes: Comparison between the various types of File Organization is required.

content.title: Concept of data security, access control and data encryption
content.notes: Importance of securing data is required.

content.title: Basic concept of parallel and distributed database
Storing data in a distributed database (DBM)
content.notes: Definitions of concepts is required. Significance of storing data in a distributed database management system is also required.
